termsIntro: Please read these carefully before booking so there is no confusion about what is included, timing, and your responsibilities.
termsHourly1: You choose how many hours you need at booking. Billing follows the published 1st-hour and extra-hour rates shown on this screen.
termsHourly2: The worker is hired only for the selected trade/skill shown here — not for unrelated jobs.
termsHourly3: Time generally starts when the worker arrives at your site and is ready to work (unless both sides agree otherwise in chat).
termsHourly4: If work runs longer than booked hours, extra time is chargeable at the extra-hour rate, subject to worker availability and agreement.
termsHourly5: Tools, materials, spare parts, and consumables are not included in the hourly rate unless clearly agreed and billed separately.
termsHourly6: Please keep the work area accessible and safe. Delays caused by site not being ready may still count toward booked time.
termsHourly7: You may cancel while we are still searching for a worker (reason required). After a worker accepts, cancellation may attract platform/payment rules shown at that time.
termsHourly8: Imagineering India connects you with nearby workers; on-site work quality and safety remain a shared responsibility of you and the assigned worker.
termsDaily1: A daily booking covers one standard working day: 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM.
termsDaily2: The worker is expected to be available for work within this window for the selected trade shown on this booking.
termsDaily3: A reasonable break (for lunch / rest) is included within the day and is not billed as overtime.
termsDaily4: Work requested before 9:30 AM or after 6:00 PM is not part of the daily rate. Extra time, if agreed, may be charged separately (typically on hourly terms).
termsDaily5: The daily fee is for labour of the listed trade only. Materials, parts, transport of heavy goods, and specialised equipment are extra unless agreed in writing/chat.
termsDaily6: Please share the exact address, access instructions, and what needs to be done before the worker starts.
termsDaily7: If the site is locked, unsafe, or not ready when the worker arrives, waiting time or a revisit may apply as per mutual agreement / platform policy.
termsDaily8: You may cancel while we are still searching for a worker (reason required). After acceptance, cancellations follow the rules shown for that booking.
termsDaily9: Leaving early does not automatically entitle a partial refund of the daily rate unless Imagineering India / the worker agree under special circumstances.
termsSpecific1: This booking is for the specific task / scope described on this listing — not for open-ended hourly or full-day hire.
termsSpecific2: Where a fixed task price is shown, it covers that listed scope only. Extra work requested on site may need a revised price before starting.
termsSpecific3: If this listing is visit / inspection based, the visiting charge (if any) is for assessment. Final work price may be confirmed after the visit.
termsSpecific4: Materials, spare parts, and third-party items needed to complete the task are usually extra unless the listing clearly says they are included.
termsSpecific5: Please describe the problem accurately (photos help). Wrong or incomplete information can delay work or change the quote.
termsSpecific6: The worker will attempt to complete the agreed task within a reasonable time for that job type; complex or hidden issues may need a follow-up visit.
termsSpecific7: You may cancel while we are still searching for a worker (reason required). After acceptance, cancellation and refund rules of that booking apply.
termsSpecific8: Approval of extra work or revised pricing should be clear before the worker proceeds beyond the original scope.
termsCommon1: Only lawful, safe work is allowed. Illegal, hazardous, or abusive requests will be refused and may lead to cancellation.
termsCommon2: Payment method chosen at booking (online / Pay on Delivery where available) must be honoured as per the amount shown, including applicable platform fee and taxes.
termsCommon3: Nearby workers are notified after booking/payment. The first to accept within the search window is assigned to you.
termsCommon4: Treat workers respectfully. Discrimination, harassment, or unsafe conditions are not allowed on Imagineering India.
termsCommon5: Disputes about work done, timing, or charges should be raised promptly so we can help mediate where possible.
termsFooter: By tapping Book now you confirm that you have read and agree to these terms for this hire type.
checkoutSubtitle: Confirm hours, site address, and payment — then we’ll notify nearby workers.
